item.title: AI Is Restructuring Production Relations: From Human-Human to Human-Machine
item.description: AI is fundamentally transforming production relations. Building on Marxist political economy and modern organizational theory, we're witnessing a historic shift from complex human collaboration to efficient human-machine synergy.
